title: Harmonize keyboard flows and color tokens for data visuals & action groups
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Scope: Bring keyboard navigation behavior, ARIA semantics, and color token mappings for contrast into alignment across interactive controls and data visual components. This ticket focuses on two deliverables: (1) a small refactor of button/action groups and table row selection to standardize focus order and visible focus rings using tokenized outline colors; (2) an accessibility hardening pass for chart interactions (hover traps, focusable legends and points) and documentation for VPAT evidence.

Goals:
- Ensure consistent tab/arrow key behavior across button groups, table rows, and chart legends so assistive technology users have predictable movement.
- Replace ad-hoc color values in charts and legends with named contrast-safe tokens that meet WCAG AA (and AAA where feasible) at the sizes we render.
- Add ARIA roles and live-region hints for interactive chart updates (filters, data refresh) without over-verbosifying the DOM.
- Produce a VPAT evidence pack (screenshots, keyboard walkthrough, annotation notes) for the next compliance review.

Out of scope: Full redesign of the data table virtualized renderer or replacing the third-party datepicker; this ticket scopes a wrapper-level accessibility fix for the datepicker integration only.
acceptance_criteria: Button groups: Tab moves into first control; arrow keys move within group; focus ring uses token 'focus-strong-on-surface' and passes 3:1 at small sizes or 4.5:1 where text is present.
Data table: Row selection reachable by keyboard; row action menu reachable by Enter/Space; row focus style uses tokenized outline.

Charts: Legends and point markers are reachable via keyboard (Tab/Arrow) where applicable; ARIA roles present and screen reader announcement for selection changes implemented as polite live-region updates.
Color tokens: Replace 6 ad-hoc hex values used in charts with tokens that pass WCAG AA against the chart background at rendered sizes; document token choices in design tokens catalog.
VPAT: Generated evidence pack with step-by-step keyboard walkthrough, screenshots, and a short remediation note for each change; attached to ticket and confluence page.
